subject: Charge for mid-cycle burst seats + VAT handling
messages:
From: Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@optera.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Steve Chan <steve.chan@optera.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Unexpected full-month charge after adding burst seats

Hi Kimberley,

We noticed a charge on our card this morning for the full month after we added 10 burst seats on Apr 15. We were expecting a pro-rated charge for the remainder of our billing cycle (Apr 15–May 14). The invoice attached (invoice_20270415.pdf) shows VAT applied at 20% — we’re an EU entity and expected reverse-charge (we’ll supply a VAT ID if that helps).

Can you explain:
- Why we were billed for the full month rather than a slice/prorate?
- Whether this can be reversed or credited against next month while we provide our VAT ID?
- If the payment gateway has duplicate charges — our finance team is seeing two approval lines.

Attached: invoice_20270415.pdf, usage_apr_15-24.csv

Thanks — this is blocking our month-end reconciliation.

Best,
Lena
Director of Finance
Optera AI
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@optera.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected full-month charge after adding burst seats

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the confusion. I’ve looped in Ben (billing ops) and Marcus (revenue ops) to get a fast answer and to propose a remediation. High level: we should have charged a prorated amount for the Apr 15–May 14 slice, and if the gateway created a duplicate authorization we’ll surface that to reconcile.

Next steps we’ll take immediately:
- Ben to confirm whether the transaction was duplicated by the gateway and initiate a reversal/void if possible.
- Marcus to prepare a provisional credit equal to the difference (full-month minus prorated slice) to apply against your next invoice if reversal cannot be instant.
- If you provide your EU VAT ID we’ll re-issue the invoice under reverse-charge (no VAT) and update our records.

Can you confirm the last 4 of the card on file and whether the finance team prefers a direct reversal or a credit? If you want us to proceed with a credit while you supply VAT info, we can provision that today.

I’ll push an internal ticket and keep you updated by EOD.

—Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@optera.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:18:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected full-month charge after adding burst seats

Kimberly / Lena — digging into payment logs now. Notes:
- There are two separate capture events against the same authorization: a capture for the prorated slice (EUR 1,760) and a second capture for the full month (EUR 9,600). The gateway accepted both because the authorization was large enough and our middleware did not dedupe due to a race on the seat activation event.
- Action I’m taking: filing a capture reversal request with the gateway for the full-month capture (EUR 9,600). Gateways usually process reversals within 3–7 business days depending on the acquiring bank; I’ll escalate with our payments partner if we hit Day 3 with no status.
- Provisional credit: Marcus, please create a provisional credit memo for EUR 7,840 (difference) in case reversal is delayed; apply to OP-4721 next invoice and leave a note to reconcile when gateway confirms reversal.

Lena — for VAT: if Optera is an EU-registered company and you can provide the VAT ID and company registration address, we’ll reissue the corrected invoice (reverse-charge). If you need the corrected invoice sooner for month-end, we can issue it now and mark the original as superseded.

Attachments: payment_log_capture_events_20270427.csv (internal) — I referenced the invoice files you sent.

ben
Billing Operations Manager
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@optera.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Steve Chan <steve.chan@optera.ai>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected full-month charge after adding burst seats

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

We confirm Optera AI VAT ID: EU123456789 and registered address: 21 Rue de la Finance, 75002 Paris, FR. Please reissue the invoice under reverse-charge and apply the provisional credit to the next invoice if the gateway reversal does not complete within 5 business days.

Payment card last 4: 4321 — yes, please attempt a direct reversal first; the finance team will accept a credit if reversal is delayed. If you need a fully signed amendment to the order so procurement can close this on our side, send the DocuSign link and I’ll route it internally.

We also need a brief confirmation email (to our AP mailbox) that the VAT has been handled under reverse-charge so our tax team has an audit trail.

Thanks —
Lena
Director of Finance, Optera AI
